test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Well, I prefer eating at home __from eating out__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"prefer eating at home from eating out" **is** incorrect.**
 
• The correct preposition to use with **"prefer" **when comparing** two activities is "to."**
 
• Thus, the correct phrase should be **"prefer eating at home to eating out."**
 
• This correction ensures the sentence is grammatically correct and clear.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Well, I prefer eating at home to eating out."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "and eating out" is incorrect as it does not convey a preference.
 
• **Option 3:** "than eating out" is incorrect as "prefer" is not followed by "than."
 
• **Option 4:** "while eating out" is incorrect as it changes the meaning of the sentence.
